description: Rejected controlled continuation of the native unified search-aware MPE/WDL preflight. It passed the exported model gate but failed the real 300k-node engine-search gate badly, so this config is retained only as a reproducible rejected result.

metadata.parent_result: model gate rerun: pt=nn exact, top1 499/1409, top3 898/1409, sum_gap 151483, median gap 19cp, worst 800cp. Net diff changed 2.81M/25.20M exported values, including 2.81M input weights and 1201 L1 weights. Quant scan showed exported input movement 11.161% and L1 movement 3.665%. This is export-visible but still below the preflight top1 threshold.
metadata.hypothesis: The mixed objective is not dead: it improved target move-choice substantially and selected the final epoch. A lower-LR continuation from the exported checkpoint, using the next 100k broad rows, tests whether it can cross the model gate without another scalar-only or local-repair loop.
metadata.baseline_model_gate: Parent exported model: top1 499/1409, top3 898/1409. Original native init model: top1 337/1409, top3 594/1409.
metadata.baseline_reference_gate: Current reference engine at 300k nodes on unified targets: top1 761/1409, top3 1130/1409; mate_like top1 108/235, non_mate top1 653/1174.
metadata.result: validate_search_targets_model passed with pt=nn exact, top1 647/1409, top3 1065/1409. Static on the next 100k broad rows improved versus parent (mae 129.63 -> 111.47, sign 76.81% -> 80.40%). Net-diff versus parent changed 1.725M/25.200M exported values, including 1.724M input weights and 290 L1 weights. Quant-scan versus parent showed exported input movement 6.853% and L1 movement 0.885%. Engine-search gate at 300k nodes rejected it: all top1 184/1409, top3 420/1409; compare all 119 candidate-better vs 1058 reference-better, capped_sum_diff_cp -150029, median_nonzero_diff_cp -276, worst_regression_cp -32000.
metadata.decision: No SPRT. Do not continue this run or launch another same-objective continuation. The next task must diagnose the model-gate/search-gate disconnect with a small instrumented engine gate before more GPU training.

validation.preflight_only: Do not run SPRT from this config.
validation.engine_gate: Rejected at 300k nodes on the unified search-aware corpus.
validation.hard_stop: Closed. Do not continue the mixed-objective continuation path without a new model-gate/search-gate disconnect hypothesis.
